title: JANUS Blue Book — Exact-Date Matched Nuclear Specificity Control Preregistration
purpose: Precommit the statistical comparison of Project Blue Book human reports near nuclear-test dates versus non-nuclear dates before inspecting the completed full public exact-date index.

blindness_contract.morphology_source: Narrative Summary text only; fixed record-card checkbox vocabulary is excluded.
required_order: only then fetch/join frozen nuclear calendar
blindness_contract.forbidden: No morphology keyword or threshold may be changed after nuclear labels are inspected without creating a new post-hoc sensitivity artifact.

primary_source_population: Publicly accessible Project Blue Book case pages carrying NARA NAIDs and linked to NARA T1206 provenance; exact-date rows only.
primary_nuclear_calendar: JANUS strict open SIPRI/IAEA-derived calendar already frozen in the POSS-I public reconstruction; no post-hoc calendar selection.

phenotypes.STARLIKE: Narrative explicitly says star-like, like/resembling a star, point of light, pinpoint(s) of light, or star-sized.
phenotypes.COMPACT_LIGHT: Broader narrative screen for colored/bright/luminous compact light/object language.
phenotypes.RESOLVED_CRAFTLIKE: Narrative resolved body language such as disc/disk/cigar/cylinder/triangle/saucer/fuselage.

endpoints.E1_all_case_incidence: Number of exact-date Blue Book case rows in nuclear windows.
endpoints.E2_any_report_day: Binary date endpoint: at least one exact-date Blue Book case on the date. Prevents a mass-report night from contributing arbitrary case multiplicity.
endpoints.E3_starlike_case_incidence: Number of STARLIKE-screened case rows in nuclear windows.
endpoints.E4_any_starlike_day: Binary date endpoint: at least one STARLIKE-screened case on the date.
endpoints.E6_morphology_composition: Among Blue Book case rows, odds that a report is STARLIKE near nuclear dates versus outside +/-4 days. This conditions on entry into the Blue Book reporting system and does not treat zero-report calendar dates as observed person-days.

N1_year_blocked_pseudo_tests.description: For each calendar year, preserve the number of unique real nuclear-test dates but draw pseudo-test dates uniformly without replacement from eligible dates in that same year; recompute +/-1 endpoints.
N1_year_blocked_pseudo_tests.purpose: Preserve large secular changes in Blue Book reporting while allowing non-nuclear months such as July 1952 to enter the null.

N2_year_month_blocked_pseudo_tests.description: Within each year-month containing real test dates, preserve the number of unique test dates and redraw them without replacement within that same month.
N2_year_month_blocked_pseudo_tests.purpose: Stricter season/month control, at the cost of conditioning on which months had nuclear activity.

N3_exact_lag_shape.description: Report observed endpoint values separately at lags -4 through +4. Pre-event structure is a confounding diagnostic and may not be interpreted as backwards causation.

model_sensitivities.daily_count: Negative-binomial or Poisson count sensitivity with year trend, annual sine/cosine, and explicit July-1952 high-media-wave indicator; interpret only as archival report incidence, not population sighting incidence.
model_sensitivities.case_composition: Logistic sensitivity for STARLIKE among case rows with nuclear +/-1 predictor plus year/season terms.
model_sensitivities.mass_wave_control: July 1952 is an explicit high-reporting non-nuclear positive-control epoch and may not be averaged away without a reported sensitivity run.

duplicate_and_exposure_boundaries.same_day_case_multiplicity: E2/E4 binary event-day endpoints are mandatory alongside case counts.
duplicate_and_exposure_boundaries.witness_count: Multiple witnesses inside one case file do not become multiple case rows.
duplicate_and_exposure_boundaries.archive_zero: A calendar day with zero Blue Book case rows means zero entries in the reconstructed archive, NOT zero people looking at the sky.
duplicate_and_exposure_boundaries.geography: Global nuclear-test proximity in time is not physical exposure; distance/site/line-of-sight are future physical-link covariates.

admission_logic.positive_nuclear_specificity: Requires positive +/-1 direction for a preregistered endpoint and survival against both year-blocked and year-month-blocked nulls, with no contradictory pre-event lag pattern and with the STARLIKE result not explainable solely by one mass-report day.
admission_logic.non_nuclear_baseline: Considered established as nonzero if STARLIKE or compact-light cases occur outside +/-4 days, independent of any nuclear-window effect.
admission_logic.failure_to_replicate: If +/-1 endpoints are compatible with the blocked nulls, nuclear temporal specificity is NOT_ESTABLISHED in this human-report layer.
admission_logic.suppression: A negative coefficient or deficit is never promoted to nuclear suppression unless it survives the same blocked nulls and does not appear at pre-event lags.

mandatory_validation_before_admission: Freeze a deterministic spot-check sample selected from the blind-index SHA-256.
Verify NARA NAID, occurrence date and phenotype wording against underlying NARA-linked record-card scans for the spot-check sample.
Blind manual adjudication of all STARLIKE positives if their count is tractable; otherwise a frozen random positive/negative sample.
Record parser error and ambiguous-date rates.
